development_history.implementation_correction: Initial predicate excluded every Text interface, incorrectly excluding noneditable controls that expose readable label text. Changed to actual EditableText plus EDITABLE state; all label text remains in full-tree identity. Fixture interface/text and exact positive assertions preserved.

contract.admission: Reuse original press_key/Enter kind, explicit native-XID provider binding, single approved observation, UUID ready/permit and exact XRes/focus/source/XKB/release guards. No new global input operation or widened toolkit binding.
contract.sealed_observation: Only noneditable controls advertising CHECKABLE/CHECKED, SELECTABLE/SELECTED or EXPANDABLE/EXPANDED add current boolean state to press_key context, hence original actions_sha256. Readable label Text interface is permitted and its complete bounded text remains hashed; EditableText plus EDITABLE keeps text/caret contract. A changed state during owner approval invalidates original proof before dispatch.
contract.window_proof: KeyState reuses the original complete, bounded, double-read AT-SPI tree, actual Parent/ref/path, role/name/text/interfaces identity, unique focused interactive node, and native binding. Full baseline rechecked before final key packet creation after permit. Password, incomplete/foreign/ambiguous tree and original budgets remain unchanged.
contract.postcondition: Enter only: same focused node and same complete tree, exactly one of the node advertised CHECKED/SELECTED/EXPANDED bits flips, in either direction. Every other node/state, reference/path and identity remains equal. Unchanged state waits only existing750ms readback budget; other changes, two flips, focus movement, new/removed children, missing capability or wrong-key state flip remain unknown without another input.
contract.lifecycle: Original cancellation and key-release ownership remains: cancellation waits for original release/query and both native connections. No second key pair, reset of input changes, timeout reduction or skipped assertion.
contract.application: Three real isolated SQLite owner flows exercise each state family: zero input before approval, exact grant/run/operation permit, one actual injected pair, key_verified receipt and succeeded run, duplicate owner request reuses original intent. These are native binary/AT-SPI injected ports on Windows, not actual Linux devices.
